_comment: Pins the circuit family, curve, prover backend, and library versions that MUST match for a ceremony transcript in this repo to be verifiable. Any deviation (different circuit revision, different gnark, different curve) invalidates the resulting VK - a verifier that recomputes vk_hash off this manifest will get a different value and reject the artefacts. Kept alongside zk/ceremony/README.md and zk/ceremony/attestations.example.json.

reproducibility.notes: The engine/go.mod pin is the source of truth for the exact gnark/gnark-crypto revision compiled into the ceremony binary; this file mirrors it for out-of-tree verifiers who do not want to parse Go modules.
